questions: Are uppercase and lowercase letters considered the same character (case-insensitive) or distinct (case-sensitive)?
Does 'identical characters' mean the same multiset (same counts of each character) or just the same set (same unique characters regardless of frequency)?
Should the function consider characters beyond ASCII, such as Unicode emojis or accented letters, and if so, are they compared by code point or normalized form?
Are empty strings allowed as input, and if so, are two empty strings considered to have identical characters?
Does the function need to handle non-string inputs (e.g., None, integers) or can it assume inputs are always strings as per type hint?
Should the function consider characters in a specific order (e.g., sorted) or just the presence/absence?
Are characters like newline (\n) or tab (\t) considered part of the string and thus compared?
If a character appears multiple times in one string but not at all in the other, does that affect the result (i.e., is frequency considered)?
